import { type JSXChildren, type QRL } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type DateValue, type Locale } from '../../internal/behavior';
import { type CalendarTranslations } from '../calendar';
import { type DateInputTranslations } from './model';
export type { DateInputTranslations } from './model';
export interface DateInputProps {
    id?: string;
    mode?: 'single' | 'range';
    value?: DateValue;
    defaultValue?: DateValue;
    onValueChange$?: QRL<(detail: ValueChangeDetails<DateValue>) => void>;
    label: JSXChildren;
    name?: string;
    form?: string;
    autocomplete?: string;
    returnFocusId?: string;
    hint?: JSXChildren;
    error?: JSXChildren;
    invalid?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    locale?: Locale;
    translations?: Partial<DateInputTranslations>;
    calendarTranslations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    withCalendar?: boolean;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
}
export declare const DateInput: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<DateInputProps>;
